notes: Replacement batteries differ by serial: RB1280A for serial numbers beginning CQD, and RB1290 for serial numbers beginning CX2.

gaps: A generic caution says 24 V, maximum 9 Ampere-hour, which conflicts with the model-specific datasheet.
The datasheet states Sine Wave output in its printed text (the manual's spec table says Sinewave), but the PDF's hidden metadata carries a 'Simulated Sine Wave' tag.
method: Manufacturer datasheet and user manual (both read as text from the PDFs, checked 2026-11-11) give the battery, charge and output figures and describe the transformer path.
The manual is shared with CP1000PFCLCD: it names RB1290 as the replacement battery.
The model-specific datasheet gives one 12 V / 9 Ah battery, so its figures are used.

comps.spec: Battery quantity 1, 12 V / 9 Ah sealed lead-acid, not hot-swappable, user-replaceable battery; replacement cartridge RB1280A (for serial numbers beginning with CQD) or RB1290 (for serial numbers beginning with CX2), replacement cartridge quantity 1
Line interactive; on battery: 60 Hz +/- 1%, 120 VAC +/- 5%, waveform Sine Wave; 850 VA / 510 W

Typical battery recharge time 8 hours from total discharge under 100% load; the battery charges automatically whenever the UPS is plugged into AC power, on or off; after a battery replacement the manual says to recharge for 8-16 hours
Transformer in the GreenPower bypass design: normally bypassed, and when utility power is abnormal the UPS runs power through its transformer to regulate voltage
